summary: WorkAdventure is a virtual office and conference application styled as a 16-bit role-playing video game. Users navigate a 2D map via avatars and can initiate video and audio calls with others who are physically close to them within the virtual space.
goodFor: Teams looking for an interactive, spatial alternative to traditional video conferencing tools for remote collaboration or virtual events.
watchOut: The dual AGPL-3.0 and Commons-Clause licensing requires careful review if you plan to modify or commercialise the codebase. Additionally, managing spatial audio and video routing for larger virtual rooms can introduce significant infrastructure overhead.
deployNotes: Deployment relies on Docker containers, which typically requires setting up a reverse proxy for TLS termination and configuring persistent storage for map assets and user data.
